description.en: Read the scope, duration and fee before choosing.

description.en: The calendar shows the times available to book.
description.am: ቀን መቁጠሪያው ለቀጠሮ ክፍት የሆኑ ሰዓቶችን ያሳያል።

description.en: Use the booking note to tell us what you would like to discuss.
description.am: ስለምን መወያየት እንደሚፈልጉ በቀጠሮ ማስታወሻው ይጻፉ።

answer.en: Sessions are available in Amharic and English. Mention your preference when booking.
answer.am: ቆይታዎች በአማርኛ እና በእንግሊዝኛ ይካሄዳሉ። ቀጠሮ ሲይዙ ምርጫዎን ይግለጹ።

question.en: What if I need a different time?

answer.en: Contact us before your appointment to discuss changing the time.
